items.title: Pure Synergy introduces a new brand identity - The Times-Independent
items.raw_summary: Rooted in nearly five decades of belief in nature’s intelligence, the Moab-based organic supplement maker debuts refreshed packaging, a new website, and a clearer way of telling the story behind its formulations Photo courtesy of Pure Synergy Pure Synergy, the organic wellness brand from The Synergy Company, has a new brand identity that was developed in partnership with Colorado-based agencies The Storied Brand and Backbone Media, according to a press release from the company. freestar.config.enabled_slots.push({ placementName: "moabtimes_incontent_1", slotId: "moabtimes_incontent_1" }); “The work spans redesigned product packaging, a new website, a refreshed voice, and a reinvigorated approach to brand storytelling,” reads the headline. Pure Synergy’s new identity emerged from a strategic exploration of contemporary wellness culture and the evolving relationship consumers have with their health, reads the press release. That work pointed to a foundational intersection between what people increasingly seek from wellness brands and what Pure Synergy has believed, practiced, and pursued throughout its history. Those principles trace back to the company’s founding when a deep respect for nature’s intelligence and confidence in people’s ability to cultivate their own vitality first shaped Pure Synergy’s formulations. “There’s a remarkable story behind Pure Synergy, and much of it has gone untold,” said Jennifer Briggs, CEO of The Synergy Company. “We set out to understand what people are looking for in wellness today and discovered just how much of that already lives in who we are. This wasn’t about creating a new story. It was about finding a more meaningful way to tell the one we’ve been living.” freestar.config.enabled_slots.push({ placementName: "moabtimes_incontent_2", slotId: "moabtimes_incontent_2" }); Pure Synergy’s ethos also informs the concept of “Personal Synergy,” the brand’s invitation for people to discover and shape their own approach to well-being. It rests on the idea that lasting health is built over time through the intelligent relationship between nature, the body, and the choices people make, and not a sole ingredient or quick fix. The new identity is designed to bring forward what sets Pure Synergy apart, from the company’s ingredient sourcing and formulation philosophy to the people, places, and discoveries that have shaped its work. “Founder Mitchell May has always been driven by a profound belief in human potential and an extraordinary curiosity about what nature makes possible,” reads the press release. “Both have guided nearly five decades of exploration and formulation, and remain at the heart of Pure Synergy today.” Pure Synergy’s organic formulations remain unchanged. The new website launched last week at thesynergycompany.com, and packaging will be refreshed on a rolling basis, with all products expected in-market in their new packaging by 2028. freestar.config.enabled_slots.push({ placementName: "moabtimes_incontent_3", slotId: "moabtimes_incontent_3" }); About Us Privacy Policy Contact Us Out of Area Subscriptions Donate Popular Categories News Outdoors Opinion Sports Obituaries Our Hometown DMCA Notices Newspaper website content management software and services
